thread:
tariq: FYI I'm seeing a run of fncall failures that are 'silently rerouted' to the fallback variant in sa-east-1. Console shows variant traffic rising but nothing flags "validation" so product thinks model got hotter.

elena: Silent reroute = our routing policy moves invalid shapes to fallback. That still consumes tokens and appears under the fallback variant. We need clearer telemetry.

zane: Example log: 
```
WARN validate.fncall req=lm-55 reason=unexpected_key path=tool.response.tags route=primary -> fallback_variant
```

metrics-bot: alert: validator-service: reason=unexpected_key count=81 route=fallback_variant sample=0.1

tariq: Two asks: (1) metrics so we can break down cost by validation outcome, (2) small UI probe on variant page showing "validation routed" with reason breakdown.

elena: Metric proposal: fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed|accepted|soft_reject|hard_reject",reason="unexpected_key|missing_field|type_mismatch|parse_error",route=...,slice=...}. Keep reason enum small to control cardinality.

zane: Add a lightweight exemplar/trace id on the metric so we can link to a redacted sample: fncall_validation_total{...} increase with exemplar="trace:abcd1234" -> link to samples API.

tariq: Samples API should default to redact fields named email, token, ssn, api_key and truncate long text > 400 chars. Retain only minimal metadata (route, variant, validator_reason).

elena: Billing: add event field validation_tag=routed to the event stream. Billing team can decide mapping to a temporary 'charge-review' bucket. For now tag-only.

zane: UX: probe tile on variant page: tiny sparkline + top 3 reasons, each reason clickable to show 10 redacted samples. Tooltip should explain what "routed" means and whether the slice is a canary. product-ui: can you design that?

product-ui: yeah we can. We'll do a compact card: title "Validation routing" small sparkline, breakdown pill list, and a link "inspect samples". Wording will avoid scary language.

elena: Alert rule idea: page if routed_rate_by_route > 1% sustained for 10m AND token_usage_by_route > baseline*1.15. Message should include top reason and exemplar trace id.

tariq: One internal API debate: should we count routed requests toward quota and rate limits? I vote yes for quota accounting but mark them separately; makes enforcement predictable.

zane: I'm leaning mark+count. If product later decides not to bill, we can retro map. But quotas rely on predictable accounting otherwise customers will hit unexpected limits.

elena: Also add a per-slice toggle: strict_validate=true|false. When toggling during canary, the UI should show validation metrics scoped to that slice so owners can correlate.

metrics-bot: deploy: feature/validation-telemetry queued to staging by elena (staging).

tariq: Implementation checklist for RFC:
- metric names + prom examples (include exemplar label)
- enum values for reason + outcome
- samples API spec + redact rules
- billing event tagging (validation_tag)
- UI probe wireframe + wording draft
- alert rule prom expression + paging message template

zane: I'll draft the RFC and include a short migration note re: backfilling historic validation tags (kafka topic retention caveat).

elena: One more: ensure sample retention defaults to 7 days and sample size limit per-reason to avoid PII exposure.

tariq: Thanks. Post RFC link here when ready and I'll run a canary at 06:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
